dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: What do you think we'll find if we go further in? I'm excited to see.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I know, everyone needs to rest after the last battle... But I'm an Outrider. I'm not used to standing around waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Make sure you don't forget to call me when you're ready to leave!
